title: Messaging selection — D1
purpose: Architecture map for Messaging selection: fan-out, rate control, event triggers, orchestration, ordering, replay, and dead-letter handling.
routing_rationale: Use the D1 lens to keep fan-out, rate control, event triggers, orchestration, ordering, replay, and dead-letter handling connected to an explicit owner, evidence path, and recovery action.
summary: Select Pub/Sub, Cloud Tasks, Eventarc, or Workflows from delivery, ordering, rate-control, and orchestration requirements.

nodes.label: Order / Event Producer
nodes.detail: The system that emits work or an event.

nodes.label: Messaging Decision
nodes.detail: The choice point for delivery, fan-out, rate, and orchestration.

nodes.label: Pub/Sub Topic
nodes.detail: Decoupled asynchronous delivery with subscriptions, replay, and dead lettering.

nodes.label: Cloud Tasks Queue
nodes.detail: Targeted delivery with retries and per-queue rate control.

nodes.label: Eventarc Trigger
nodes.detail: Routes supported provider or custom events to a target.

nodes.label: Workflows
nodes.detail: Coordinates steps, retries, and service calls.

nodes.label: Consumer Service
nodes.detail: Processes the message or event and reports outcome.

nodes.label: DLQ / Replay / Retry
nodes.detail: Prevents poison messages from silently disappearing.

steps.title: Architecture map: Order / Event Producer → Messaging Decision
steps.action: Order / Event Producer publish work to Messaging Decision; record evidence for fan-out, rate control, event triggers, orchestration, ordering, replay, and dead-letter handling.
steps.why_traversal: Trace the primary decision path for Messaging selection by making Messaging Decision an explicit review boundary.

check.commands: record and verify e1 for Messaging selection

steps.title: Architecture map: Messaging Decision → Pub/Sub Topic
steps.action: Messaging Decision fan-out / replay to Pub/Sub Topic; record evidence for fan-out, rate control, event triggers, orchestration, ordering, replay, and dead-letter handling.
steps.why_traversal: Trace the primary decision path for Messaging selection by making Pub/Sub Topic an explicit review boundary.

check.commands: record and verify e2 for Messaging selection

steps.title: Architecture map: Messaging Decision → Cloud Tasks Queue
steps.action: Messaging Decision rate-control to Cloud Tasks Queue; record evidence for fan-out, rate control, event triggers, orchestration, ordering, replay, and dead-letter handling.
steps.why_traversal: Trace the primary decision path for Messaging selection by making Cloud Tasks Queue an explicit review boundary.

scenarios.label: The selected service cannot meet delivery semantics
scenarios.root_cause: Fan-out, rate control, event routing, or orchestration needs are mismatched.
scenarios.diverted_path: The Messaging selection path stops at the affected boundary and the evidence trail becomes incomplete.
scenarios.blast_radius: Consumers of Messaging Decision and any downstream decision depending on it.
scenarios.recovery: Re-evaluate the requirement matrix before implementation.

scenarios.label: A consumer repeatedly fails
scenarios.root_cause: Retries amplify load or a message blocks useful work.
scenarios.diverted_path: The Messaging selection path stops at the affected boundary and the evidence trail becomes incomplete.
scenarios.blast_radius: Consumers of Consumer Service and any downstream decision depending on it.
scenarios.recovery: Use bounded retries, dead lettering, and an operator replay path.

scenarios.label: Orchestration grows without a boundary
scenarios.root_cause: A multi-step process has no timeout, idempotency, or compensation plan.
scenarios.diverted_path: The Messaging selection path stops at the affected boundary and the evidence trail becomes incomplete.
scenarios.blast_radius: Consumers of Workflows and any downstream decision depending on it.
scenarios.recovery: Set explicit timeouts and record compensating actions.
